title: Each government that pays toward an NBA arena, its households, its deals' public money per household and the ZIP code areas inside it

note: level is 1 for a city (and the District of Columbia), 2 for a county, 3 for a state. zips lists the ZIP code areas (2020) with at least 95% of their land inside the government; zips_part those with 5% to 95%. A household in a city or county also pays its share of the state's money where the state pays.
method: with pay as ( select i.team, sum(b.public_2026_m) filter (where g.payer = 'visitors') / sum(b.public_2026_m) as visitors_share, sum(b.public_2026_m) filter (where g.payer = 'shared') / sum(b.public_2026_m) as shared_share, sum(b.public_2026_m) filter (where b.bucket = 'sales') / sum(b.public_2026_m) as sales_share from buckets b join items i using (item_id) join bucket_groups g using (bucket) where i.kind <> 'ongoing' and not (i.kind = 'project' and i.description ilike '%district%') group by i.team), h as ( select *, case when geo_id = '04000US11' then 1 else case substr(geo_id, 1, 3) when '160' then 1 when '050' then 2 else 3 end end as level from households), z as ( select geo_id, list(zip order by zip) filter (where land_share >= 0.95) as zips, list(zip order by zip) filter (where land_share < 0.95) as zips_part from zip_geo group by geo_id) select h.geo_id, h.jurisdiction, h.level, h.households, list({'team': h.team, 'arena': a.arena, 'label': case when h.deal ilike '%new%arena%' then a.arena || ' and the new arena' when h.pending_2026_m > 0 then a.arena || ', with the pending rebuild' else a.arena end, 'per_household_2026': h.per_household_2026, 'share': h.share, 'pending_2026_m': h.pending_2026_m, 'visitors_share': coalesce(p.visitors_share, 0), 'shared_share': coalesce(p.shared_share, 0), 'sales_share': coalesce(p.sales_share, 0)} order by h.team) as deals, coalesce(any_value(z.zips), []) as zips, coalesce(any_value(z.zips_part), []) as zips_part from h join arenas a using (team) left join pay p using (team) left join z using (geo_id) group by h.geo_id, h.jurisdiction, h.level, h.households order by h.level, h.jurisdiction
